title: Bond and Mason Reviews: Is Bond & Mason Legit, and Are the Bags Good Quality?
title_tag: Bond and Mason Reviews 2026: Is It Legit? | Kinsley Deals
description: Is Bond & Mason legit? It's rated 4.2 out of 5 on Trustpilot from 2,543 reviews, with 323 at 1 star. What the €27 bags are like, returns and who it suits.
excerpt: Is Bond & Mason legit, and are its €27 vegan leather bags good quality? Its Trustpilot rating, the praise and complaints, the "was €110" prices and the return rules.
image_alt: The Bond & Mason Christy handbag in vegan leather
lede: Bond & Mason sells vegan leather handbags, totes, crossbody bags, clutches and backpacks online at bondandmason.com. People search "bond and mason reviews" and "is bond and mason legit" before they buy, so here's what its ratings say, what the bags cost and what the return rules are.

parts: Bond & Mason is a real store that ships orders: 2,543 Trustpilot reviews average 4.2 out of 5, and most buyers say the bags look good for the price. But about 1 in 8 reviews gives 1 star, mostly over quality and returns, and the "was €110" prices next to €27 bags shouldn't be read as the bags' value. Buy it as a low-cost bag, not a luxury one.

The best sellers when we checked were handbags and totes priced €27 to €30: the Palmer Tote Bag, the Christy, Bridget, Alicia and Amari handbags, the Fiona Clutch Bag and the Havana Shoulder Bag. The product pages list 100% vegan leather, a fabric lining and gold- or silver-tone hardware, with sizes in centimeters and inches.
Prices in euros checked on November 19, 2026.

figure.alt: The Bond & Mason Palmer tote bag

parts: Most reviews are short and positive: pretty bags, good material for the price, an easy website, and some repeat buyers on their fifth or sixth order. Some say delivery took longer than expected but the bag was worth the wait.

The negative reviews say the bags look and feel cheap for what was paid, with one comparing them to Temu, and that the returns process is hard. That matches the policy: you pay return postage and no label is provided.

It's a working store with a claimed Trustpilot profile and thousands of buyers, so orders do arrive. What it doesn't show is a business address: the contact page is empty, Trustpilot lists the Netherlands, and the store's account lists Sheung Wan, Hong Kong. It ships from warehouses around the world.
The "was" prices of €110 to €115 next to €27 sale prices are the store's own figures. We couldn't find these bags sold at those prices, so judge them at €27.

At €27 to €30, with free shipping on most orders, a Bond & Mason bag costs about what a high-street vegan leather bag costs on sale. The risk is the return: if you don't like it, postage back is yours, which can eat a good part of a €27 refund.
Our [Bond & Mason discount code guide](saving-tips-bond-and-mason-discount-code.html) lists every way to pay less, with prices side by side.

list: 4.2 out of 5 on Trustpilot from 2,543 reviews
Low prices, €27 to €30 for the best sellers
Free standard shipping on most orders
30-day returns and a 5-year quality guarantee mentioned on the home page
You pay return postage, and no label is provided
"Was" prices of €110 that the bags don't seem to sell at
No business address on the site

parts: Bond & Mason suits shoppers who want a trendy vegan leather bag for under €30 and are fine keeping it. It's a poor fit if you want a bag to last for years, or if you'd likely send it back.
